companyFocuses.name: Makeblock
companyFocuses.role: Manufacturer of educational robotics construction platforms and the mBlock programming ecosystem
highlights: Makeblock’s manufacturer-authored education catalog spans screen-free mTiny, Codey Rocky interaction, Arduino-oriented mBot/Ranger/Ultimate construction and CyberPi-based mBot2. The Spring 2022 portfolio is historical evidence, not a complete current or historical lineup audit.

Controller and programming scope differ: original mBot uses mCore; the mBot/Ranger/Ultimate Arduino-platform kits support blocks and Arduino C. mBot2 uses CyberPi, while Codey Rocky supports blocks and Python. A board or software feature is not automatically included in every kit.

Classroom multi-unit packs, maps, storage cases, AI cameras, Smart World and Rover add-ons have separate package/accessory scope. They are not automatically additional whole-robot models or standard hardware of a base robot.

Manufacturer educational benefits, AI/IoT projects and curriculum alignment are positioning. Independent learning outcomes, current cross-platform app support, stock, exact package contents and exclusive advantages remain unverified.
